en.headline: Customs seize over a tonne of smuggled frozen meat and food from Chung Ying Street route
en.dek: Nine people were arrested after officers intercepted vans carrying roughly 570 kg of frozen meat and 500 kg of other food believed to have entered via Sha Tau Kok.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it had broken up a suspected smuggling operation that moved frozen meat and other food from the mainland through Chung Ying Street in Sha Tau Kok before distributing the goods to markets and residential addresses.

On 3 November officers stopped three vans and seized about 570 kilograms of suspected smuggled frozen meat together with roughly 500 kilograms of other food, including seafood, vegetables and prepared items. The haul was estimated at around HK$140,000. Nine people, eight men and one woman aged 23 to 58, were arrested. They included a man suspected of illegally importing the goods, four van drivers, a fresh-provision shop operator and three recipients. All were released on bail pending further inquiries.

Investigators said the syndicate mixed the meat with cooked food, used multi-stage delivery from a distribution point in Yau Ma Tei, and advertised online with claims of cold-chain transport that were not accurate. The meat travelled for more than four hours in ordinary foam boxes, some with melted ice packs and some without any refrigeration. Customs and the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department warned that selling meat from unapproved sources can lead to licence revocation.

Under the Import and Export Ordinance, importing unmanifested cargo can attract a fine of up to HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment. Importing refrigerated or frozen meat without a Food and Environmental Hygiene Department permit is also an offence.

zh.headline: 海關破中英街走私凍肉案 檢逾噸貨拘9人
zh.dek: 海關截查貨車，檢獲約570公斤凍肉及500公斤其他食品，相信經沙頭角中英街入境後分銷至街市及住宅，9人被捕。
body: 香港海關表示，已搗破一個懷疑經沙頭角中英街從內地走私凍肉及其他食品到香港，再分發至街市及住宅的集團。
海關人員於11月3日截查三輛客貨車，檢獲約570公斤懷疑走私凍肉及約500公斤其他食品，包括海鮮、蔬果及預製食品，估計市值約14萬元。行動中拘捕8男1女，年齡介乎23至58歲，包括一名涉嫌非法進口的男子、四名貨車司機、一名新鮮糧食店負責人及三名收貨人。所有被捕人士現正保釋候查。
調查顯示，集團將凍肉混入熟食運送，採用分層派送，先運至油麻地分貨點再轉運各區。網上廣告聲稱有冷鏈運輸及保證新鮮，但實際貨物以普通發泡膠箱盛載，部分冰種已融化，有的甚至沒有冰種，運送時間超過4小時。海關及食環署提醒，售賣非核准來源肉類可被撤銷牌照。
根據《進出口條例》，輸入未列艙單貨物最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁7年。輸入冷藏或冷凍肉類而沒有食環署進口許可證亦屬違法。
